title: Planner retrodiction

plan_before_cutoff.facility_name: Novespace parabolic flight (0.16 g up to 25 s, 0.38 g up to 30 s)
plan_before_cutoff.rationale: Moon base and pressurized rover (34% oxygen, 8.2 psia, lunar gravity), thin fabric, upward/concurrent: untested in the evidence so far. Novespace parabolic flight (0.16 g up to 25 s, 0.38 g up to 30 s) gives 0.160 g for about 25 s, enough for a spread-rate measurement. Risk weight 1.62, gap weight 1.0, cost tier 2.

burn_distance_note: LUCI rates were published in 2025, so this table explains facility limits after the fact; the retrodiction itself uses the facility catalogue's minimum test times, not LUCI's rates.
honesty_note: Weights were frozen before this run, but by a team that already knew LUCI flew; the null baseline and the 1,000-draw sensitivity show how much the result depends on that choice.
